title: Invoice Hands
oneLiner: Invoice Hands collects your supplier invoices from their portals for you.
forWhom: freelancers who lose an hour a month downloading PDFs

app.open: Clone the team repository and run `hackathon setup`, or watch the steps below: every screenshot is the real app.
app.signIn: Sign in with the account you created when you claimed the instance.

steps.title: Add a portal
steps.do: Click `Add a portal`, pick `Example Energy` and paste the demo login.

steps.title: Fetch the invoices
steps.do: Say "fetch my invoices" into the microphone button.
steps.see: A browser agent opens the portal; after about 30 s three PDFs appear in the list.

tryThis.title: Watch the agent work
tryThis.text: Open `Runs`: the live view shows the agent clicking through the portal in a real browser.
